lastCompletedStory.title: Drive the parity check from bun test so CI enforces it and the bash script gets source-guard coverage

nextStoryContext: US-004 added test/check-gitignore-parity-script.test.ts, driving the real scripts/check-gitignore-parity.sh (US-002) via Bun.spawnSync so it now runs under `bun test` (and therefore under check:all in CI) instead of depending on a manual run. 4 tests: (1) parity leg -- zero exit + no `DIVERGE ` line against this repo root; (2) non-vacuity leg -- the `PROBES=<n>` stdout line parsed and asserted > 10 (a floor well below the live count, currently 42, but far above the script's own zero-probe hard-fail); (3) source-guard leg -- asserts the script TEXT contains no hand-written artifact literal (checks absence of 'cam-worker-events' and '.cam-sidecar-liveness-watcher', both real artifact names, to catch a regression back to an enumerated list); (4) fail-closed leg -- a throwaway mktemp repo holding only a copy of templates/.gitignore and no src/ tree makes the script's own BASES/second-grep derivation collapse to zero probes; asserted exitCode===2 (the script's own contract code) AND stdout contains the exact 'FAIL: derivation produced zero probes' message, not just 'non-zero', so a real subprocess crash could never be mistaken for the legitimate fail-closed verdict. Falsifiability swept by mutating templates/.gitignore DIRECTLY on disk (no embed-vendor round-trip needed for this script, unlike the embedded-copy test in US-003: check-gitignore-parity.sh does `cp templates/.gitignore` straight off disk) -- confirmed RED for (a) deleting the `.claude/cam-worker-events.jsonl` line (repo root still ignores it, template no longer does -> DIVERGE) and (b) substituting `scripts/cam/scope-proposal.json` with a blanket `scripts/cam/*` (now ignores `scripts/cam/prd.json`/`scripts/cam/handoff.json` on the template side only, both of which are live derived PROBES today since they're referenced by quoted literal in src -- DIVERGE), then green again after each restore (byte-identical diff, embed-vendor:check clean). GATE-SPINE NOTE: file-size, coverage, dead-code, dup, ci-parity all passed unmodified for this story; no budget file needed a raise. No new stories remain unassigned to me from this PRD's spawn context; check prd.json for the next pending US-XXX -- if none remain, this may be PRD_COMPLETE territory for the next iteration.
